datasets.name: SPOT-5 optical images
datasets.verbatim: The optical image in this case study was captured by SPOT-5 on 20 May 2009 with a spatial resolution of 2.5 m.

datasets.verbatim: four scenes of ALOS PALSAR are acquired from the European Space Agency (ESA) Online Dissemination

datasets.name: Pixel-level landslide inventories
datasets.verbatim: First, pixel-level landslide inventories of the two catchments are prepared for learning and testing.

methods.name: Integrated machine learning (ML) powered method for co-seismic landslide detection
methods.summary: The method integrates multi-source data (optical, SAR, DEM) with both pixel-based and object-based treatments. It uses machine learning algorithms (LR, SVM, RF, CNN) to train models for landslide detection, with image segmentation (eCognition) used for the object-based treatment.
methods.source: Haojie Wang, Limin Zhang, et al.
methods.verbatim: This paper presents an integrated machine learning (ML) powered method for co-seismic landslide detection, which combines multi-source data, pixel-based and object-based treatments, and ML techniques.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom method code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
